exclude: all rankings and target-to-candidate shortlist associations

territorial_adjudication.control_confirmed_rule: Requires affirmative independent evidence covering the frozen event window and candidate location that explicitly establishes no activation; documentary silence is insufficient.
territorial_adjudication.excluded_active_rule: Requires affirmative independent evidence of activation at the candidate location during the frozen event window.
territorial_adjudication.outcome_unknown_rule: Use whenever evidence is incomplete, spatially ambiguous, temporally incomplete, non-independent, or merely silent.

event_window.adjudication_window_rule: Source must explicitly cover the local event day and relevant activation interval; no temporal shifting to fit candidate evidence.

hard_fail_closed: candidate code not in frozen seven
candidate coordinates or scientific metrics differ from committed clean-room input
matching hash differs from frozen hash
attempt to expose target codes, names, IDs or outcomes
attempt to use contaminated adjudication artifacts
attempt to browse unrestricted web sources
attempt to replace or rerank a candidate after territorial evidence
attempt to infer CONTROL from absence of a report
